Hi Marta —

Thanks for sending the certificate and the summary. Quick heads-up: our accounting team flagged a name mismatch between the state registration on the certificate (GreenPrint Logistics Inc.) and the billing entity on the PO (GreenPrint Logistics LLC). That mismatch triggers an invoice hold until we receive either:

1) a notarized or state-certified copy that shows the LLC name mapping to the Inc. (DBA/transfer documentation), or
2) an updated W-9 that matches the name on your PO, or
3) a signed affidavit + a notarized resale certificate that includes a clear state seal and seller registration number.

Marcus — can you please run an EIN and vendor-name cross-check in NetSuite and confirm whether we can accept the current paperwork as-is or if we need a corrected W-9?

Marta — we can accept a certified digital signature (DocuSign) if that's easier; I included a DocuSign link below that our compliance team accepts. If you plan to send a notarized PDF, please include a high-res scan of the state seal and the signatory block.

DocuSign (optional): https://app.docusign.com/US-1234-verify?envelopeId=ABCDEF123456

Thank you — we'll try to move the invoice ASAP once the documentation clears.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
